sloka: हा तात हा पुत्रक कान्त मित्र हा जीवितं भोगयुतं सुपुण्यम् ।रक्षोभिरेवं बहुधा ब्रुवद्भिः शब्दः कृतो घोरतरः सुभीमः ।। 5.54.41 ।।।।
transliteration: hā tāta hā putraka kānta mitra hā jīvitaṁ bhogayutaṁ supuṇyam ।rakṣobhirevaṁ bahudhā bruvadbhiḥ śabdaḥ kṛto ghorataraḥ subhīmaḥ ।। 5.54.41 ।।।।

translations.english: With the Fire god spreading flames all over, heroes dead, retreating troops shattered by Hanuman's anger, Lanka appeared as though it was cursed.
